verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a POS testing system that simulates transaction scenarios. It covers an Adyen test card, ordered from the test Customer Area, for testing card brands, CVMs and declines, and simulated acquirer responses, all explicitly meant to validate the integration before switching to live. Adyen itself calls the system 'basic'. missing for 10: evidence of a software-simulated reader or terminal (testing appears to rely on physical test hardware), depth of end-to-end scenario coverage beyond the listed cases, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can test my in-person integration end-to-end with a simulated reader or test card environment before going live

citations.quote: We provide a basic testing system to simulate transaction scenarios and functionalities. You can use this system to ensure your test integration is working as expected, before you switch to an integration that can make live transactions.
You can order an Adyen test card from your test Customer Area... Using the Adyen test card, you can: Test different card brands. Test different CVMs. Test declined payments.
Simulate various acquirer responses to test your handling of declined transactions.
